pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e1: I propose a goal bonus, an appearance bonus and a title bonus, at a level that reflects his value.
We should reshape the fixed salary in favour of goal, appearance and title bonuses.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e2: My client prefers to earn where he makes a difference, so I need a model from you.
I want to know who hands out the bonuses at your club and by what key.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e3: I can tell the air is thin, but the bonus question still has to go on the table.
I know the timing is unfortunate, but silence will not shrink the question.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e4: On the fixed salary we are far apart, but variable parts might still bring us together.
I realise the club has been on the brakes so far, so I am offering a point on bonuses where we could meet.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e5: We are close in principle, only the bonuses are missing, then the package is complete.
Nearly everything is settled, the variable part remains, and I would like to nail it down today.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e6: The overall package is still movable, and the bonus structure can tip it either way.
Both sides are still open, and I think the bonuses will decide whether it works.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e7: Either goals get paid, or we talk about something else entirely!
A contract like that is a joke if a goal is worth nothing!
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e8: You once promised me an incentive that never made it onto paper, so this time I want it in writing.
I already had a verbal promise, nothing was delivered, so I insist on a bonus model with a signature.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e9: He does not want to cause the club trouble and only asks whether variable parts could give him security.
He is attached to the club and wants the bonuses shared fairly across the whole squad.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.e.e10: Anyone who wins trophies should see it in his account, and my client is counting on that.
Elsewhere they pay clearly more for trophies and goals, and that should give you pause.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a1: We tie a part to appearances and goals, but only when the team succeeds along the way.
A performance-based bonus system is feasible, as long as we do not inflate the fixed part.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a2: I will have a bonus scale drawn up for goals, appearances and titles. You get the paper within {frist} days.
Fine, we will build in the variable parts, and within {frist} days you will have a written draft.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a3: I am putting a cap on the total of all bonuses. Otherwise goal and title bonuses throw my pay structure off balance.
The club carries only limited risk, so there is an upper limit on total bonuses.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a4: I will top up the bonus pot so every goal pays off, but please not at the first penalty.
Then I will add extra bonuses for titles and goals, noting only that defenders are allowed to score as well.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a5: I understand that security matters to him. One part stays fixed, and the variable part comes on top as a bonus.
He should not have to fear for his income at every dip in form. That is why the base stays stable.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a6: The bonus keys are decided by our sporting director together with the management. I am happy to arrange the contact.
Please turn to the management, that is where the guidelines for success bonuses are kept.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a7: Which incentives does he want in concrete terms, and what would he be willing to give up?
Which matters more to him, the goal bonus or the title bonus, and how much fixed pay would he sacrifice for it?
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a8: I refuse bonuses for individual players. That tears the dressing room apart, and I will not be blackmailed.
There is no room for that with me. Whoever wants more money should prove it on the pitch, not on the phone.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a9: It stays with the model as written in the contract. I will not negotiate it a second time.
I am sticking to it, you will get no extras, however often you call.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a10: I will look into it in peace. Sooner or later we will surely find a solution.
Let us discuss it after the season, there is no rush.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a11: Our cooperation has been fair so far, and it should stay that way. I will find a way that gives him recognition without tearing my squad apart.
Your client deserves recognition for his performance, and I want him to feel it. Together we will get this done.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.a.a12: There will only be team bonuses: those who win, win together, and I am striking individual goal bonuses.
I pay bonuses only to the whole squad, not to individual names.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r1: {b.gut} That sounds like a model we can work with.
{b.gut} With that I can go back to my client.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r2: {b.gut} He will appreciate the fairness, and so will I.
{b.gut} The club shows a sense of proportion, I will note that.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r3: {b.gut} Title bonuses, exactly what he wanted to hear. That spurs him on even more.
{b.gut} If success is written into the contract too, he will run that bit further.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r4: {b.gut} He will appreciate that you take his worry seriously.
{b.gut} The cushion gives him peace, and calm players deliver.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r5: {b.neutral} I will take that away, but I promise nothing.
{b.neutral} I will pass it on as it is and get back to you.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r6: {b.neutral} I will explain it to him calmly, how he takes it I cannot say.
{b.neutral} His mood changes daily, I will talk to him tomorrow.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r7: {b.neutral} Then the variable part remains the swing factor.
{b.neutral} Both sides are keeping their cards close, and the bonuses remain the sticking point.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r8: {b.neutral} A few more days do not matter to me.
{b.neutral} I am patient, that goes with my trade.

{b.schlecht} That leaves me little room, and he will not take it well.

{b.schlecht} You underestimate how angry he can get!
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r11: {b.schlecht} Then I will examine the offers with better bonuses more closely.
{b.schlecht} There are clubs that reward success more generously.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r12: {b.schlecht} He hoped for so much from this conversation and will be very disappointed.
{b.schlecht} After all these years I would have expected more goodwill.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r13: {b.gut} Then we close the bonuses and can prepare the signature.
{b.gut} That clears the last open point, I am confident.
pool.verhandlung_praemien.r.r14: {b.schlecht} Then we are even further apart than I thought.
{b.schlecht} With that attitude we will not come together, I say that openly.

pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e1: I put a figure on the loyalty bonus in an attachment and ask for feedback on amount and payment date.
I set out our demand for a signing bonus in writing, please respond by the weekend.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e2: Without a one-off payment on signing I see no agreement, so I ask for a fair offer.
Please check whether the club can bear a signing bonus of a sensible size, it would be a strong signal.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e3: I know the relationship is strained at the moment, and yet the signing bonus is a topic I cannot skip.
The mood is bad, I can see that, but this question belongs before the signature.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e4: I suspect the club is struggling, but please consider a staggered payment so that we do not fail.
The talks are stalling, a signing bonus in instalments might be the way out before the whole thing collapses.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e5: We are close to signing, only the signing bonus is still open, so let us settle it quickly.
The contract is nearly finished, only the one-off payment is missing, and then we can sign.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e6: The signing bonus is our lever, and with it the overall picture can still move in either direction.
Everything is still movable, and a one-off payment could be the decisive factor.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e7: Without a signing bonus he will not put a stroke on the paper, and that is my final word!
He will not be tied down for pocket money, please read that carefully!
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e8: You once promised me a loyalty bonus that never came. This time I expect it before the signature.
A word given about a one-off payment was not kept, so I now insist on clarity on paper.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e9: He would be pleased with a gesture for the extension, I leave the amount to you.
Appreciation counts for him, and a loyalty bonus would be the visible proof.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.e.e10: Anyone who takes his career seriously gets paid for committing, and my client does the same.
A signing bonus is not charity, it is the price for turning down other offers.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a1: I will pay the signing bonus on signature. The commitment comes in writing, and the contract should be done within {frist} days.
Agreed, the club bears the one-off payment, and in return he signs within {frist} days.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a2: I will split the sum into instalments tied to appearances and staying in the squad.
Staggered it would be feasible, one part on signing, the rest after the first half of the season and at the end of it.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a3: What does he offer in return? An extension without a release clause would be a start.
What does the club get in return, more years, a waiver of the clause?
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a4: A signing bonus only comes against something in return, namely length and waiving the clause. The sum has to work out for both.
We pay for commitment, not for a signature alone. Whoever stays long also gets more.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a5: We have worked together fairly for a long time. I am looking for a solution that honours his performance without overburdening the club.
Your client means something to us, and I want to show him that, in a way that everyone can bear.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a6: A signing bonus is not on the table here. Whoever wants to stay should do so out of conviction and not for cash.
I do not pay for a signature. I tell you that as plainly as I can.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a7: Please turn to the club: signing bonuses are approved by the board, not the sporting side.
The club keeps the purse. Send your demand to the board, I will give no recommendation on it.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a8: My position stands. You will receive no one-off payment from me, not even on the third attempt.
That is how it stays, I give no signing bonus, and another letter changes nothing.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a9: I will see to it as soon as the situation allows. It will work itself out.
A signing bonus can surely be arranged at some point, for now I ask for patience.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a10: There are no loyalty bonuses here, that is club policy and I will not bypass it.
There will be no special payment for an individual, that applies to everyone in the squad.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a11: I understand that he wants to see appreciation. I will show it to him another way, in conversations and in the line-up.
It is about recognition for him, I have understood that. Money is only one way among many.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.a.a12: A loyalty bonus is nice, but I would like to know whether it also applies retroactively for all the years in which he earned well with us.
A signing bonus sounds lovely, but my bank statement also has a claim to a say in it.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r1: {b.gut} That is an offer I can put to my client with a clear conscience.
{b.gut} I can work with this answer, thank you for the clear line.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r2: {b.gut} He will appreciate the gesture, and so will I.
{b.gut} I like the tone of your reply, that is how partners negotiate.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r3: {b.gut} A payment for clear performance, that is entirely in his spirit.
{b.gut} He will read every instalment as a spur, and he will supply the performance.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r4: {b.gut} That you take his feelings seriously weighs more for him than any number.
{b.gut} He felt seen, and I credit your reply for that.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r5: {b.neutral} I will forward your reply and keep you posted.
{b.neutral} Thank you for your message, I will consult my client.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r6: {b.neutral} How he takes that I cannot predict, he is one way today and another tomorrow.
{b.neutral} I will read him your lines calmly, whether he agrees remains open.

{b.schlecht} He will take that personally, and I will not hold him back!

{b.schlecht} There are plenty of clubs that pay for a signature.

{b.schlecht} The answer hits him deeply, and I can see how hard he will take it.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r13: {b.gut} Then practically nothing stands in the way of the signature.
{b.gut} I will prepare the paperwork, the one-off payment is settled.
pool.verhandlung_handgeld.r.r14: {b.schlecht} Then we are definitely not on the same line, and I say that without resentment.
{b.schlecht} That seems to be it for an agreement, I fear we are both wasting time.

pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e1: At his age he needs security, so I demand a long term and fewer clauses.
He is no longer the youngest and wants to be covered until the end of his career, which means a long term.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e2: He is young and wants no long shackles, so a short term with higher pay.
For his age a long contract is a ball and chain, I argue for a short term with better pay.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e3: The mood is not the best, but I still have to talk about the length, because the decision brooks no delay.
I can feel the tension, but on length we are far apart, and that has to go on the table.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e4: I do not believe we will meet here unless someone moves on the length.
On duration we face each other like two walls, perhaps something can be built in the middle.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e5: Almost everything is settled, we only need to talk about the length once more.
All that is missing is an agreement on the duration, then the contract stands.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e6: The length decides which way it tips, and I hope we find a middle path.
Everything is still possible, and the duration is the lever with which the package can be rearranged.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e7: Either we agree on a sensible length, or the talks are over!
I will not sign a length that is dictated to me, even if it means a fight!
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e8: You held out an extension option that never got written down, so I now insist on a clear length.
The verbal promise on duration was not kept, so this time I only talk about paper.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e9: He wants a bond that shows trust and sees the length as a sign of how much he is wanted here.
The duration of the contract means a lot to him because it shows whether he has a future here.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.e.e10: My client does not want to commit before he knows where the club is heading.
I consider short contracts the wiser choice, because they keep him free to plan anew with me at any time.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a1: He gets a long term, with development steps in his pay. The draft will be with you within {frist} days.
I offer long security with performance steps and will put the contract to you within {frist} days.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a2: I propose a short term with an extension option. The paper comes within {frist} days.
Short and flexible is possible if the club gets the extension option. Within {frist} days I will send the drafts.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a3: We meet in the middle: a medium term, with a review after a year.
A year less than the club wants, a year more than your client wants, that is my proposal.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a4: A long term helps both, he can plan, and we can invest in him.
A long contract protects him from fluctuations in form, so I consider it wise.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a5: I understand his wish for security. He should know that he has a future here.
The uncertainty of a short contract can weigh heavily, I take that seriously.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a6: What matters more to him, security or freedom, and what would he be willing to trade for it?
How does he see himself, rather as a man for the moment or as one who stays?
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a7: Contract lengths are set by the sporting director with the management, I will gladly put you through.
Please speak directly with the management, that is where the guidelines lie.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a8: The length is fixed, no more and no less, and your pressure changes nothing.
I do not negotiate the duration, full stop.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a9: I refuse a release clause after a short time. Then he could leave every summer.
There is no contract with a back door with me.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a10: We will sort that out, the duration will resolve itself.
Do not worry about the length, in the end it will fit.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a11: We know each other, and I want to keep him. Tell me openly what matters to him and I will build it in.
I value your client and am looking for a length that suits his circumstances.
pool.verhandlung_laufzeit.a.a12: A contract is not a marriage, but a few years are allowed.
Short contracts are like short breaks: nice, but you have to keep repacking.
